mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP2D6, significantly increasing atomoxetine plasma concentrations; combined noradrenergic and serotonergic activity increases cardiovascular and CNS risks.
action: Reduce atomoxetine dose by 50% when combined with fluoxetine; monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and for serotonergic symptoms; consider alternative SSRI with lower CYP2D6 inhibition.
